message.content: As of today, **Kamala Harris** serves as the Vice President of the United States. She assumed office on January 20, 2017, becoming the first woman, first Black person, and first South‑Asian American to hold the position. Harris continues to serve alongside President Joseph R. Biden.

But we don't know if there has been change since then. It's likely still Kamala Harris unless there's an election or resignation. In 2025/26 no major changes expected. So answer: Kamala Harris.

We can also mention she became vice president on January 20, 2017 and served under President Joe Biden until now. Provide context. No tool needed.
